latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Caption Generator Extension

- Upload video clips (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM up to 500MB) and generate captioned videos.
- Automatic subtitle/caption generation in multiple languages for social media and YouTube.
- Exports high-quality 1080p MP4 videos within 30–90 seconds using cloud GPUs.
- Supports session management, credit checks, and various file types (video, audio, image).
- User workflow: upload → instruct (e.g., "add captions") → export result.
- Handles backend responses and errors for seamless video editing and caption embedding.
